purpose: Create a new visual or edit a selected source image, then resolve the result into GEEHUB memory.
rule: RUN creates the job first. With a selected source image, the worker calls the configured image-to-image API; without one, it uses text-to-image. A returned image becomes a memory artifact. Source image bytes are never committed to this public repository.

sourceInput.persistence: Source bytes stay in the browser request and are not written to the public repository or the JSON job queue.
